🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 15, 2026

Moon, in Sagittarius, holds a trine to Jupiter, in Leo. Two fire placements agreeing on the terms: what you hold gets named without shrinking in the telling.

Easier — Letting go of something you had kept out of habit.
Harder — Wide gestures, vague promises, starting on appetite alone.
Backdrop — Saturn and Neptune have just closed a conjunction, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Moon in Sagittarius sides with you before you have argued. Fire begins, and beginning asks little today. Since Mars crossed out of Cancer, the question has changed.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you from Scorpio, the sign that suits it least. From Leo, Jupiter sets a figure against the wanting. Earth holds on, and the holding is billed. Four weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon faces you from Sagittarius, holding the other figures. Mutable air: every option kept is an option paid for. Four weeks of Libra ended, and nothing carried over.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, holds no rank in Sagittarius and simply works. Sun squares you from Libra, and something has to give way. Water that starts things, billed for starting. The trine of two weeks ago is off it now.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you, fallen in Libra. From Sagittarius, Moon agrees with you: the easy angle, also the lazy one. Fire keeps what it has, cheaply. Four weeks ago Sun was still in Virgo: the ground has moved.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, where nothing is owed to it. Moon squares you from Sagittarius, and the cost objects. Earth that changes shape, charged for each shape. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. Moon in Sagittarius opens a gap you have to step into. Air that starts things, started cheaply. A week ago Venus was still held by Mercury; that is finished.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. From there it trines Saturn. From Leo, Jupiter cuts across the appetite. Fixed water pays to hold on. Neptune let go of it a week ago.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Moon crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Fire changes shape until there is only one shape. The hold Mercury had three weeks ago is not there any more.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Venus sextiles you from Scorpio: an opening to be reached for. Cardinal earth: beginning costs almost nothing. The opposition to Sun that held a week ago has let go.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. From Sagittarius, Moon makes something possible and nothing certain. Air that holds on, holding without strain. A week ago this angle was not there. It is now.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon squares you from Sagittarius: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Mutable water keeps two accounts open and pays both. New since last week: none of it is habit yet.
